name: rnn-lstm-from-scratch
primer:
Conventions: inputs X are one-hot, shape (B, S, V); targets Y are (B, S) longs; hidden size H.
Parameters are a dict of tensors with requires_grad=True; a linear is x @ W + b with W (in, out).
Training uses torch autograd (loss.backward() then a manual SGD update under torch.no_grad()).
The RNN and LSTM share one train/sample path — you pass rnn_logits or lstm_logits as forward_fn.
Every other function in this project is also available in your namespace at grade
time — call earlier steps by name; you do not import them. Run
`uv run python projects.py rnn-lstm-from-scratch` (or the outline drawer) to see all signatures.
title: Build an RNN and LSTM from Scratch

parts.title: Character Data
parts.description: Build a character vocabulary, encode text to ids, make next-char training windows, and one-hot encode.

parts.title: Vanilla RNN
parts.description: Implement the recurrent cell, unroll it over a sequence, and project hidden states to vocab logits.

parts.title: LSTM
parts.description: Implement the gated LSTM cell (input/forget/output/candidate), unroll it, and project to logits.

parts.title: Loss & Training
parts.description: Sequence cross-entropy, the loss over a model's logits, an SGD step (torch autograd), and the training loop.

parts.title: Sampling & Evaluation
parts.description: Sample the next character with temperature, autoregressively generate text, and measure perplexity.

steps.name: build_char_vocab
steps.doc: Build sorted character-to-id and id-to-character mappings from text.

steps.name: encode_text
steps.doc: Map each character in text to its integer id, returning a LongTensor (L,).

steps.name: make_training_pairs
steps.doc: Split ids into non-overlapping windows X and next-char targets Y, dropping the remainder.

steps.name: one_hot
steps.doc:
One-hot encode an integer id tensor along a new last axis of size vocab_size.

Return a float32 tensor (NOT long); the hot index along the new last axis is 1.0.

steps.name: init_rnn_params
steps.doc:
Create the trainable parameter dict for a vanilla RNN.

Return a dict with keys "Wxh" (vocab_size,hidden), "Whh" (hidden,hidden), "bh" (hidden,), "Why" (hidden,vocab_size), "by" (vocab_size,); weights small random (~0.1*randn) seeded by seed, biases zero, all float32 with requires_grad=True.

steps.name: rnn_cell_step
steps.doc:
Advance the RNN hidden state by one time step.

Return h_t = tanh(x_t @ params["Wxh"] + h_prev @ params["Whh"] + params["bh"]); shape (B, hidden).

steps.name: rnn_forward
steps.doc:
Unroll the RNN cell over the sequence axis starting from h0.

If h0 is None use a zeros(B,hidden) initial state. Apply rnn_cell_step at each t; return (H_seq, h_last) where H_seq stacks all hidden states along dim=1 with shape (B,S,hidden) and h_last is the final (B,hidden) state.

steps.name: output_logits
steps.doc:
Project hidden states to vocabulary logits.

Return H_seq @ params["Why"] + params["by"], shape (B,S,vocab_size).

steps.name: rnn_logits
steps.doc: Run the RNN from a zero initial state and produce logits.

steps.name: init_lstm_params
steps.doc:
Initialize LSTM weight/bias tensors (4H gate block ordered [i,f,o,g]) as small random requires_grad params.

Return a dict with keys "Wx" (vocab_size,4*hidden), "Wh" (hidden,4*hidden), "b" (4*hidden,), "Why" (hidden,vocab_size), "by" (vocab_size,); the 4*hidden axis is the concatenated [i,f,o,g] gate block; weights small random (~0.01*randn) seeded by seed, biases zero, all float32 with requires_grad=True.

steps.name: lstm_gates
steps.doc:
Compute the LSTM input, forget, output, and candidate gates for one time step.

Compute z = x_t @ params["Wx"] + h_prev @ params["Wh"] + params["b"], split z into four (B,hidden) blocks in order [i,f,o,g], and return (sigmoid(i), sigmoid(f), sigmoid(o), tanh(g)).

steps.name: lstm_cell_step
steps.doc:
Advance the LSTM cell and hidden state by one time step using the gated update.

Using gates (i,f,o,g) from lstm_gates, compute c_t = f*c_prev + i*g and h_t = o*tanh(c_t); return (h_t, c_t), each (B,hidden).

steps.name: lstm_forward
steps.doc:
Unroll the LSTM cell over the sequence axis, returning all hidden states and the final h and c.

If h0 or c0 is None use a zeros(B,hidden) initial state for it. Return (H_seq, h_last, c_last) where H_seq stacks all hidden states along dim=1 with shape (B,S,hidden) and h_last,c_last are the final (B,hidden) states.

steps.name: lstm_logits
steps.doc: Run the LSTM from zero initial states and project the hidden sequence to vocabulary logits.

steps.name: sequence_cross_entropy
steps.doc: Mean cross-entropy of (B,S,V) logits against (B,S) integer targets.

steps.name: compute_sequence_loss
steps.doc: Run forward_fn to get logits, then return their sequence cross-entropy.

steps.name: train_step
steps.doc: One SGD step: zero grads, backprop the sequence loss, update params in place, return the float loss.

steps.name: train_model
steps.signature: train_model(params, X_onehot, targets, lr, n_steps, forward_fn)
steps.doc: Run n_steps of train_step and return the list of per-step losses.

steps.name: sample_next_char
steps.doc: Sample one character id from the temperature-scaled softmax of a (V,) logit vector.

steps.name: generate_text
steps.signature: generate_text(params, stoi, itos, prompt, length, forward_fn, temperature=1.0, generator=None)
steps.doc: Autoregressively generate `length` new chars after `prompt` by sampling the model's last-step logits.

steps.name: sequence_perplexity
steps.doc: Return the perplexity (exp of mean cross-entropy) of the model on the given data.
